title: Title
confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete this?
welcome_desc: Browse profiles of the world's best players, follow the latest news, and play live games against opponents from around the world.
featured_hint: Only one news article can be featured at a time. Selecting this will remove the featured flag from any other article.
highlight_hint: Only one player can hold each highlight at a time. Toggling will automatically unset the previous holder.
play_intro: Play live, ranked games against other registered players.
no_open_challenges: No open challenges right now. Use quick pairing to post one.
draw_offered_waiting: Draw offered — waiting for your opponent.
link_intro: If you are a player listed in our database, you can request to link your account to your official player profile. An admin will review and approve.
link_security_note: Linking only displays your official profile next to your account. You cannot edit official profile data — only admins can.
register_subtitle: Join to play ranked games and track your progress.
verify_subtitle: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Enter it below to verify your account.
code_resent: A new code is on its way.
leaderboard_subtitle: The highest-rated active players on the platform.
play_cta_sub: Live, rated games with server-checked moves and fair clocks.
manage_users_sub: Browse, ban, unban, verify, or unlink platform users.
watch_live_intro: Live games happening right now. Spectate freely.
no_live_games: No live games match your filters.
select_thread: Pick a conversation on the left.
chat_disabled_admin: Chat has been disabled by an admin.
spectator_chat_readonly: Spectators can read but not send.
game_voided: This game was voided by an admin.
admin_chat_intro: Review and moderate chat across the platform.
confirm_abort: Abort this game? It will end with no rating change.
void_reason_prompt: Reason to void? (rating will be reverted)
notif_email_desc: Emails about your account, such as profile-link decisions. Security emails are always sent.
notif_dm_desc: Let other players send you direct messages.
notif_game_chat_desc: Chat with your opponent during games. When off, chat is closed in your games.
notif_sound_desc: Move sounds, alerts and the low-time warning.
action_failed: That didn't work. Please try again.
admin_abort_body: The game ends with no result and no rating change, and both players are told.
approve_link_body: The player's account will show this profile. It confers identity only, never editing rights.
reject_link_body: The player is told, with your note if you leave one.
article_no_content: This article has no text in this language yet.
article_not_found_body: It may have been unpublished or removed.
ban_body: They are signed out at once, their challenges are withdrawn, and any game they are playing is aborted without a rating change.
block_body: You won't see each other's messages, and neither of you can challenge the other. You can unblock at any time.
blocked_players_desc: People you have blocked can't message or challenge you.
board_shortcuts: Tip: click a piece and then a square, or drag it. ← → step through the moves, F flips the board, right-click draws arrows.
challenge_player_placeholder: Search for a player, or leave empty for the lobby
change_password_desc: Changing your password signs you out on every other device.
chat_hidden: Chat is hidden on this device.
chat_muted_you: A moderator has muted you from chat.
chat_off_in_settings: You turned game chat off in your settings.
check_spam: Can't find it? Check your spam folder.
code_sent_on_login: Your email isn't verified yet, so we've sent you a new code.
confirm_abort_body: The game ends with no result, and nobody's rating changes.
confirm_resign_body: Your opponent wins, and the result counts toward your rating.
custom_game_intro: Choose the colour, time control and rating range, or challenge a specific player.
dashboard_subtitle: What's happening on the platform right now.
delete_account_body: Your name, email and picture are removed and you can't sign in again. Finished games stay in your opponents' history as "Deleted player". This can't be undone.
delete_player_body: The profile is removed and any account linked to it is unlinked. This can't be undone.
delete_string_body: This custom string is removed in both languages.
reset_string_body: Both languages go back to the built-in text.
display_name_hint: Shown instead of your username. Leave it empty to use your username.
dms_closed: This player isn't accepting direct messages.
error_body: Something went wrong while showing this page. Reloading usually fixes it.
first_move_you: Make your first move — {{seconds}}s left before the game is aborted
forgot_password_subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a code to set a new password.
game_not_found_body: The link may be wrong, or the game no longer exists.
image_hint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to 5 MB. Large images are resized.
image_too_large: That image is larger than 5 MB.
invalid_code: That code is invalid or has expired.
language_hint: Also the language of the emails we send you.
leaderboard_empty: No rated games yet. Play one to get on the board!
link_rejected_toast: Your profile link request was declined
link_request_sent: Request sent. An admin will review it.
load_failed: Couldn't load this. Check your connection and try again.
manage_link_requests_sub: Players asking to be linked to an official profile. Approving confers identity only; it never grants editing rights.
news_intro: Tournaments, results and stories from the chess world.
news_title_required: Give the article a title in at least one language.
not_found_body: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.
notifications_desc: Choose what can reach you, and how.
one_seek_at_a_time: You can have one open lobby challenge at a time. Cancel it to post another.
password_changed_body: You've been signed out on your other devices.
password_reset_done: Your password has been reset, and you're signed in.
pending_link_requests_banner_one: {{count}} link request is waiting for review
pending_link_requests_banner_other: {{count}} link requests are waiting for review
player_not_found_body: This player doesn't exist, or their profile isn't public.
players_intro: Profiles of the world's leading players.
profile_picture_desc: Shown next to your name across the site. Square images work best.
provisional_note: A ? marks a provisional rating: fewer than 10 games played, so it moves faster.
quick_pairing_hint: Pick a time control. You'll join a waiting player at once, or wait in the lobby for the next one.
rating_history_empty: Play a few rated games to see a rating chart.
rating_history_label_one: Rating went from {{from}} to {{to}} over {{count}} rated game
rating_history_label_other: Rating went from {{from}} to {{to}} over {{count}} rated games
region_hint: Which language edition shows this article.
rematch_waiting: Rematch offered — waiting for a reply
reset_code_note: The code is valid for 15 minutes. Resetting signs you out everywhere else.
reset_password_subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your email and choose a new password.
sessions_desc: Signed in on a device you no longer use? Sign out of every other device at once.
sign_out_everywhere_body: Every other device and browser signed in to your account will be signed out.
signed_out_elsewhere: Signed out of all other devices
site_strings_sub: Every piece of text on the site, in both languages. Leave a field empty to use the built-in text.
strings_footer: {{shown}} strings shown. Changes are saved when you click Save.
verify_missing_email: Open this page from the registration form, or register again.
void_body: The result is erased, and both players' ratings and records go back to how they were.
waiting_in_lobby: Your challenge is in the lobby.
session_ended_expired: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
